description: Source code implementing cryptographic certificate utilities for QUIC protocol, including functions for creating self-signed certificates, adding signature algorithms, and handling X.509 names.

methods.name: AddEcdsa256SignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Adds ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 signature algorithm to a CBB buffer.

methods.name: AddName
methods.description: Adds an X.509 distinguished name to a CBB buffer based on a string input.

methods.name: CBBAddTime
methods.description: Adds a timestamp to a CBB buffer in ASN.1 format.

methods.name: CBBAddExtension
methods.description: Adds an extension to a CBB buffer with specified OID and contents.

methods.name: IsEcdsa256Key
methods.description: Checks if an EVP_PKEY is an ECDSA P-256 key.

methods.name: MakeKeyPairForSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Generates an ECDSA P-256 key pair for self-signed certificates.

methods.name: CreateSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Creates a self-signed X.509 certificate using a given key and options.
